questions.question: What happens if you use the trailer hand valve while driving?

options.text: It can cause your trailer to skid.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can cause your trailer to skid.
questions.explanation: Never use the trailer hand valve while driving. Using it can cause your trailer to skid.

questions.question: What are placards?

options.text: Diamond-shaped warning signs on vehicles carrying dangerous materials
A type of tire for snowy conditions

questions.correctAnswerText: Diamond-shaped warning signs on vehicles carrying dangerous materials
questions.explanation: Placards are diamond-shaped warning signs placed on vehicles carrying hazardous materials. They identify what type of dangerous cargo is being transported.

questions.question: When driving in fog, what should you NOT do?
questions.explanation: In fog, slow down, use your low beam headlights and fog lights, and turn on your four-way flashers. Never speed up in foggy conditions.

questions.question: What does an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) do?

options.text: Makes you stop in a shorter distance.
Makes you need a longer distance to stop.
Helps you keep control while braking.

questions.correctAnswerText: Helps you keep control while braking.
questions.explanation: ABS helps you stay in control when braking. It does not necessarily reduce the distance needed to stop.

questions.question: How do you secure a second trailer before connecting it?

options.text: Place wheel chocks under the wheels.

questions.correctAnswerText: Place wheel chocks under the wheels.
questions.explanation: Use wheel chocks to secure the trailer while connecting it. This is especially important if you are unsure about the trailer's brakes.

questions.question: What happens if brake pads get too hot?

options.text: The brakes will become extra sensitive.
The air compressor will cool the brakes.

questions.explanation: When brakes get too hot, they can fail. This happens because heat causes expansion and chemical changes that make brakes less effective. This is called "brake fade."

questions.question: When disconnecting a triple trailer, which trailer should you uncouple first?
questions.explanation: Always uncouple the third trailer first. Then uncouple the remaining trailers as you normally would.

questions.question: What does rust around wheel nuts mean?

options.text: The nuts need to be replaced.
The nuts are the wrong size.

questions.explanation: Rust around wheel nuts is a sign they may be loose. Check how tight they are if you see rust.

questions.question: Why are broken suspension parts dangerous?

options.text: They need repair but not immediately.

questions.explanation: The suspension system holds up your vehicle and its load, and keeps the axles in place. Damaged or missing parts like spring hangers, shock absorbers, and u-bolts are very dangerous.

questions.question: What can extremely hot temperatures cause?
questions.explanation: Heat causes air inside tires to expand, which increases tire pressure. This can cause tires to fail. Check your tire pressure regularly in hot weather.

questions.question: If a traffic light has been green for a long time, what will likely happen?

options.text: It will probably stay green as you approach.
It will likely turn yellow soon.
It will skip yellow and change directly to red.

questions.correctAnswerText: It will likely turn yellow soon.
questions.explanation: When you approach a traffic light that has been green for a long time, it will probably turn yellow before you reach it. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What color are emergency air lines usually coded?
questions.explanation: Service air lines are coded blue. Emergency air lines are coded red.

questions.question: What should you do if a pre-trip inspection finds something unsafe?

options.text: Continue the trip and get it fixed after you are done.
Let a more experienced driver take the truck.
Avoid using the unsafe parts but continue driving.

questions.explanation: You must fix any unsafe issues found during a pre-trip inspection before driving. It is illegal to drive an unsafe vehicle.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in fog?
questions.explanation: In fog, use your low beam headlights and fog lights, even during the day. High beams will reflect off the fog and make it harder to see.

questions.question: Why are double and triple trailers harder to handle?

options.text: They need more space to stop than smaller vehicles.
They are easier to maneuver on steep hills than smaller vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: They need more space to stop than smaller vehicles.
questions.explanation: Because of their size, double and triple combinations need more room to turn and stop than smaller vehicles. Drivers must be aware of the space around their vehicle.

questions.question: What happens if oil and water build up in your air tanks?

options.text: The brakes may not work correctly.
The brakes will be very sensitive.

questions.correctAnswerText: The brakes may not work correctly.
questions.explanation: Drain your air tanks daily to remove water and oil. Too much oil and water in the air tanks can damage your brakes.

questions.question: Which one is NOT a tire problem to check for?

options.text: Radial and bias-ply tires used together
Recapped tires on the front of a school bus
All tires are made by the same company

questions.correctAnswerText: All tires are made by the same company
questions.explanation: Check tires for: wrong air pressure, excess wear, cuts or damage, tread separation, dual tires that touch each other, mismatched sizes, mixed radial and bias-ply tires, damaged valve stems, and regrooved or recapped tires on school bus front wheels. It does not matter which company made the tires.

questions.question: When correcting a drive-wheel braking skid, what should you NOT do?

options.text: Remove your foot from the brake pedal.
Turn quickly in the direction of the skid.
Countersteer after the vehicle is back on course.

questions.explanation: To correct a drive-wheel braking skid: Remove your foot from the brake so locked wheels can roll again. Steer quickly in the direction you want to go. Then countersteer to prevent skidding the other way. Do not accelerate.

questions.question: What is improper coupling?
questions.explanation: Drivers of doubles and triples must couple and uncouple trailers correctly. Improper coupling and uncoupling is extremely dangerous.

questions.question: What is a risk of driving in extremely hot weather?

options.text: You should not drive at all.
You must remove oil from the engine.
Tire pressure can increase to dangerous levels.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tire pressure can increase to dangerous levels.
questions.explanation: Heat causes air in tires to expand, which increases tire pressure to dangerous levels. Make sure your engine has enough oil and coolant to prevent overheating.
